 K-State men’s basketball battles Missouri in exhibition loss 
 WIBW News Update 1 Oct. 22, 2026 By Jason Kinander Published : Oct. 23, 2026 at 10:06 PM CDT | Updated : 4 hours ago Share Add Us On Google Add as a preferred source on Google MANHATTAN, Kan. (WIBW) - K-State men’s basketball lost to Missouri in an exhibition game on Friday night in Bramlage Coliseum. The Tigers took down the Wildcats 71-67.
 Jaden Schutt and Montana Wheeler each scored 12 points to lead K-State. Freshman guard Jason Crowe Jr. led all scorers with 21 points for Missouri.
 K-State squares off with Nebraska in another exhibition game on Monday, Oct. 26.
